parsed.title: Discussion on AI Tools, Job Search, and Development Practices

topics.title: Using AI for job search and resume generation

claims.text: The author plans to set up an automated system (OpenClaw) to find vacancies, generate PDFs of resumes, and write cover letters.
AI skills like Cursor, Claude Code, LLM, RAG, Embeddings are now essential for job seekers in 2026.
The market view of AI has shifted from a niche startup idea in 2024 to a mainstream requirement in 2026.
The author expects the recruiting profession to become obsolete.
Using GPT to generate SQL joins and other code speeds up development, reducing routine work.
Generated code can be low quality, insecure, and cause performance problems in production.
In some projects, AI-generated code was rejected after review due to inadequacy.

topics.title: Limitations of AI in problem solving

claims.text: Simple models cannot grasp accumulated context and personal problem‑solving experience.
